from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel
import requests

app = FastAPI(title="ONDC Payment Gateway")

# Model definitions
class ONDCPayment(BaseModel):
    transaction_id: str
    amount: float
    context: dict

@app.post("/ondc/payments")
async def create_ondc_payment(payment: ONDCPayment):
    # Transform ONDC request to Bank API format
    bank_request = {
        "amount": payment.amount,
        "currency": "INR",
        "accountId": payment.transaction_id,
        "description": f"ONDC payment {payment.transaction_id}"
    }
    
    # Call original bank API
    response = requests.post(
        "https://api.bank.com/v1/payments",
        json=bank_request
    )
    
    if response.status_code != 200:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=response.status_code, detail="Payment failed")
    
    bank_response = response.json()
    
    # Transform to ONDC format
    return {
        "transaction_id": bank_response["id"],
        "status": "COMPLETED" if bank_response["status"] == "completed" else "PENDING",
        "amount": bank_response["amount"],
        "timestamp": bank_response["createdAt"]
    }
